title: Gigli’s characterization of Alexandrov curvature

result.label: Gigli’s characterization of Alexandrov curvature
result.statement: Proves Gigli's conjecture: in every integer dimension n ≥ 2, Alexandrov curvature at least κ is characterized by the full-support RCD ((n-1) ,n) condition with reference measure H^n and distributional sectional curvature at least κ in the original global test classes. The RCD condition is unreduced.
